title: VegSim: A Geospatial World Model for Scenario-Conditioned Vegetation Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.21961v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vegetation monitoring under climate stress requires answering not only how it will evolve given the expected weather, but how it would respond to alternative meteorological conditions. Forecasting models return the expected vegetation state for the observed weather and cannot answer these scenario-conditioned questions, because future weather is fixed to the recorded trajectory. We present VegSim, a geospatial world model for scenario-conditioned vegetation simulation. VegSim infers a latent vegetation state from sparse satellite-derived NDVI histories, past meteorological covariates, and static spatial context, propagates it forward under future weather forcing through recurrent latent dynamics, and decodes predictive NDVI quantiles at each lead time. Because future forcing enters as a controllable input, the same trained model supports probabilistic forecasting under observed weather and conditional simulation under user-defined me

translated_title: VegSim：一个用于情景条件化植被模拟的地理空间世界模型
translated_abstract: 气候压力下的植被监测不仅需要回答植被在预期天气下将如何演变，还需要回答植被对不同气象条件的响应。现有的预测模型只能返回在观测天气下的预期植被状态，无法回答这些情景条件化的问题，因为未来天气被固定在已记录的轨迹上。我们提出了VegSim，一个用于情景条件化植被模拟的地理空间世界模型。VegSim从稀疏的卫星NDVI历史数据、过去的气象协变量和静态空间上下文中推断潜在的植被状态，通过循环潜在动力学在未来天气强迫下将状态向前传播，并在每个预测时长解码出预测的NDVI分位数。由于未来天气强迫作为可控输入进入模型，同一个训练好的模型既支持在观测天气下的概率预测，也支持在用户定义的气象情景下的条件模拟。
tldr: VegSim是一个地理空间世界模型，可从稀疏卫星数据推断植被潜在状态，并通过将未来天气作为可控输入，实现观测天气下的概率预测和用户自定义气象情景下的条件化植被模拟。
en_tdlr: VegSim is a geospatial world model that infers latent vegetation states from sparse satellite data and treats future weather as controllable input, enabling both probabilistic forecasting under observed weather and scenario-conditioned vegetation simulation under user-defined meteorological scenarios.
